prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, select new flows (desktop summon), targeted hints (photo upload, path decision, sign-in security), single-click and card carousel layouts, and desktop quick control redesign significantly improved metrics.
Harmful changes (worse): Specific copy changes (streamlined path selection, companion name certification), an account persistence hint, and the spotlight path selector layout significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info/loading indicators, incentives, and several alternative copy, layout, and flow variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains were frequently overestimated across tests, including +15.0% (measured +7.0%) and +14.0% (no clear effect).
Predictions too low: Gains were underestimated for multiple winning tests, including home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%), path helper hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), and single-click layout (+2.8% vs +5.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -9.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% over 1 test(s)

- choose_path, hint: +1.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +1.1% over 4 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +5.7% over 1 test(s)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Visibility & Control Onboarding Flow: Adds a dedicated onboarding step explaining desktop hotkeys, tray controls, and visibility settings right before completing setup. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control or unhide the desktop pet, and finish step conversion is only 69.4%.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Decision Companion Showcase Screen: Adds an introductory visual screen showing ready-made vs custom photo creation before path selection. (why: Choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s and drop-off rate of 22.1%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Before Waiting Reorder Flow: Moves sign-in after pet waiting generation to preserve momentum through adoption. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (64.2%), so deferring sign-in keeps momentum going.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Clarity and Retry Guidance Hint: Adds explicit photo upload quality guidelines covering lighting and face positioning. (why: Support recorded 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly, and adoption drop-off is high.)
4: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Confirmation Layout: Switches the adoption certificate screen to a two-column side-by-side design featuring pet portrait alongside details. (why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s / mean 1017s with 64.2% conversion.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Arrival Completion Action Copy: Updates headline and button text on home_intro screen to clearly direct users to launch pet onto desktop. (why: Support reports confusion regarding pet desktop visibility post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is 69.4%.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Setup Status & Progress Bar: Enables visual progress indicator and rendering status copy on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen takes a median of 201s / mean 2336s; clear visual feedback prevents perceived stalls.)

scores.note: Addresses high drop-off at finish step supported by user inquiries; desktop control flows have proven successful.
Showcase screens have shown no clear effect in past tests and lack support ticket evidence.
Reordering sign-in after adoption directly targets the highest funnel drop-off and is a proven winning change.
Photo upload guidance hint addresses top drop-off step with direct support evidence and strong historical lift.
Layout adjustments at adoption step have positive track record, though evidence is funnel-only.
Backed by support feedback, but copy modifications have consistently underperformed or harmed metrics.
Wait time indicators and status copy showed no clear effect in prior testing.
